responsibility: This header declares the high-level semantic diagnostic formatting API used by the mc front end. It exports the family of metaError/metaErrors helpers for one to four substituted arguments, with both current-token and explicit-token forms and DynamicStrings-message variants, defining the public interface for building structured semantic errors and warning chains on top of mcError.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration surface for GmcMetaError.cc, listing the fixed-arity metaError/metaErrors entry points, token-specific variants, and DynamicStrings-based forms without the formatting and error-construction logic.
